docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
The inscriptions of the Buddhist and Hindu cave temples of Western India, from Nasik, Karle, Kanheri and other sites, read by Bhagwanlal Indraji and edited by James Burgess (Bombay, 1881). Listed in the catalogue of the Rare Book Society of India.

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Digitised by the Indira Gandhi National Centre for the Arts / Archaeological Survey of India; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: Inscriptions from the Cave-temples of Western India · Burgess, Jas; Pandit., Bhagwanlal Indraji · 1881, 216 scanned pages. Published 1881; James Burgess died 1916 and Bhagwanlal Indraji 1888; public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The pages are shown as scans in this library's viewer (zoom, pan, thumbnails); the machine reading of these scans is not good enough to be shown as text.
